blocked_scope: serial-section Block-A rows (R-11 territory, H-06 scope)
STDS remote catalog rows (would require new downloads; needs separate approval under D-111)
GEO T_agg-only extras beyond the 18 R-02-frozen sections (I-030 scope)

contact_rule.note: Meaningful only where tumor labels exist (USZ, HTAN-carcinoma, STCRC-tumor*). Cohorts without tumor labels record IT_class as NOT_APPLICABLE, never inferred.

duplicate_symbol_policy: AGG-SUM: multiple Gene-Expression GRCh38 rows for one symbol are summed before ranking (D-148 lineage). No external alias tables.
fail_closed_rules: Unknown barcode join key format -> sniff documented variants else section skipped with reason
HTAN 8578 TMA: a barcode matching >1 piece index -> whole capture skipped
Coordinate cross-check (array lattice vs pixel*scalefactors) median mismatch >5um on Visium-standard cohorts -> section skipped
Xenium extent sanity: bounding box must be <20mm per side and >0.5mm, else skipped
HD tar: member scan budget 120s, extraction budget 8GB transient; exceed -> section NOT_RUN with reason
Any unhandled loader exception -> section row with skip reason, run continues

CytAssist_FFPEv2.xy: hex lattice from array_row/array_col; pixel cross-check via scalefactors

HTAN_Visium.extent_um: array lattice; pixel fallback only if scalefactors verifiable

VisiumHD_FF.binning: 16um bins if member present else 8um, then aggregate to 55um pseudo-grid

Visium_v1_GEO.xy: hex lattice from array_row/array_col (sniffed header or fixed 6-col v1 layout)

Xenium.binning: rasterize cells to 55um pseudo-Visium hex (atlas emulation); counts summed per bin
Xenium.xy: native cell centroids in um (parquet x_centroid/y_centroid)

goal_id: tls-pool-expand (tracked as TODO #29-32; no new /goal object created)
input_policy: All inputs already local. No new downloads, no GPU, no paid resources. Storage floor 1.2TB respected; transient peak budgeted <25GB.

label_policy.GSE175540: TLS vs NO_TLS from per-sample TLS_annotation.csv.gz; T_agg and blank stay unknown
label_policy.HTAN_subset: lymphoid_follicle vs all other labeled spots from Heiser pathology CSVs joined on barcode with piece check
label_policy.STCRC: IC aggregate_* FAIL-CLOSED as TLS (prior boundary kept); no TLS class exists here
label_policy.USZ: ground_truth TLS vs NOR (D-038 authorized columns)
label_policy.unlabeled_cohorts: blind pool only; no label-derived columns are computed

new_data_gate: D-111 does not trigger: every byte read is already on local disk. Any future fetch needs a fresh evidence-gap note + user approval.
null_rule: Within-section permutation of the AUCell score across bins/spots, then identical quantile+components pipeline; report observed components, null median, observed/null ratio.

per_section: diagnostics.json (coverage, verifier metrics, null contrast, skip reasons)
outputs.retention: small tables only; large intermediates stay out of git per repo hygiene

qa_verifiers.coverage: fraction of the 57 signature symbols present per section; Xenium panel stratum reported separately
qa_verifiers.labels_where_available: recall of known TLS/lymphoid spots in mask; AUC vs background (USZ/GSE175540/HTAN-subset)

round_cap_note: Bounded attempt: one primary run; no threshold sweep (Q fixed), no gradients, no inversion in this round.
score: AUCell over the signature, aucMaxRank=floor(5% of section gene count), rank 1 = highest expression (D-157 implementation, copied verbatim)

sections.note: 18 R-02-frozen sections; list read from infra/gobp_external_qualification_20260925/run_contract.json selected_sources; assert count==18
14 rows from internal_validation_manifest.json; pathology CSV per section for label verifier (IC-aggregate FAIL-CLOSED)
Recomputed under the v3 operator (AGG-SUM everywhere); v2 numbers are superseded for pool purposes

sections.matrix: stream cell_feature_matrix.h5 + cells.parquet + gene_panel.json from outs.zip (no morphology tif extraction)
stream cell_feature_matrix.h5 + cells.parquet + gene_panel.json from outs.zip (no morphology tif extraction)

signature.coverage_floor: report per-section coverage; Xenium stratum is panel-restricted by construction and reported separately, never pooled numerically with Visium counts
signature.genes: B panel (49 voted, marker_proxy_combined.json classes.B) + plasma (r16.axes.PLASMA_GENES) + CXCL13/CCL19/CCL21/LTB; resolved to 57 symbols
signature.source: identical lineage to D-157; re-derived from the same local files, never hand-written
